summary: Require environment bearer authentication for HTTP MCP, protect non-loopback binds with TLS, and encode each required code-orchestration path ID.
reason: An unauthenticated MCP listener can execute advertising API operations, while raw or ambiguous path substitutions can target the wrong resource.
validated_outcome: HTTP MCP requires a bearer token and TLS outside loopback; path placeholders are required, independently encoded, reject dot-only IDs, and are ordered when repeated.
